title: Nepali OSS Libraries
tagline: Date converters, formatters, validators, and helpers
description: Open-source libraries for Bikram Sambat ↔ AD conversion, Nepali number formatting, phone validation, address utilities, and language helpers. The opensource-nepal organization maintains the flagship Python and JS packages; ecosystem extends across Java, Kotlin, Dart, PHP, .NET, Go, Rust, and C.
